name: IHG One Rewards Premier Credit Card

localized_names.en: IHG One Rewards Premier Credit Card

apr.notes: Purchase and cash advance APRs vary with the market based on the Prime Rate.

categories.label: Qualifying purchases at IHG Hotels and Resorts
Travel excluding IHG purchases that qualify for 10x
Dining at restaurants including takeout and eligible delivery services

rewards.redemption_notes: Points earned during a billing cycle are automatically transferred to IHG One Rewards after the end of each billing cycle.

signup_bonus.description: Earn 140,000 bonus points after spending $3,000 on purchases in the first 3 months from account opening.

benefits.title: Authorized user bonus
benefits.description: Earn 10,000 bonus points after adding an authorized user in the first 3 months from account opening.

benefits.title: Automatic Platinum Elite Status
benefits.description: Automatic IHG One Rewards Platinum Elite status as long as you remain an IHG One Rewards Premier cardmember.

benefits.title: Anniversary Free Night
benefits.description: Anniversary Free Night each account anniversary year with a current point redemption cap of 40,000 points; cardmembers can add points for hotels above that level.

benefits.title: $100 statement credit and 10,000 bonus points
benefits.description: Earn a $100 statement credit and 10,000 bonus points each calendar year after spending $20,000 in purchases.

benefits.title: Redeem 3 Nights, Get 4th Night Free
benefits.description: Receive every fourth Reward Night free on eligible IHG reward stays of four or more consecutive nights at the same property.

benefits.title: Diamond Elite Status after annual spend
benefits.description: Qualify for Diamond Elite Status through December 31 of the following year after $40,000 or more in purchases each calendar year.

benefits.title: Global Entry, TSA PreCheck or NEXUS statement credit
benefits.description: Receive a statement credit of up to $120 every four years as reimbursement for a Global Entry, TSA PreCheck or NEXUS application fee charged to the card.

benefits.title: United TravelBank Cash
benefits.description: Receive up to $50 United TravelBank Cash each calendar year after registering the card with your MileagePlus account.

benefits.title: Baggage Delay Insurance
benefits.description: Reimburses up to $100 a day for up to 3 days for essential purchases when baggage is delayed over 6 hours.

benefits.title: Lost Luggage Reimbursement
benefits.description: Provides reimbursement up to $3,000 per covered traveler for lost, damaged or stolen checked or carry-on baggage during a covered trip.

benefits.title: Purchase Protection
benefits.description: Covers eligible new purchases for 120 days against damage or theft up to $500 per item.

benefits.title: Trip Cancellation and Interruption Insurance
benefits.description: Reimburses eligible prepaid, non-refundable travel expenses up to $5,000 per covered traveler and $10,000 per trip for covered cancellations or interruptions.

travel_perks.hotel_status: Automatic IHG One Rewards Platinum Elite Status; Diamond Elite Status after $40,000 in purchases each calendar year.
